Theo: quick drop 1 1 — I'm experimenting with a 'Route Preview' panel for Alerting where you can see how a given alert would map to channels + transformations before you send a preview. mock: https://figma.redwood/route-preview-v1
Rina: love this. two immediate asks: show whether the mapping uses a fallback route and surface which rules matched. UX idea: small tags on each row like 'primary', 'fallback', 'transform:strip-pii'.
Marcus: agree on tags. also we should surface 'delivery mode' for previews: Simulated vs Routed vs Canary. previews default to Simulated (not sent). Canary should be opt-in per-channel.
Yara: accessibility and copy nits: label the panel "Route preview (simulated)" and include a prominent status pill "Simulated — not delivered". make sure pill has role=status and is in tab order. palette: use neutral blue for info, not warning.
Theo: implementation notes: preview pipeline will run routing rules but short-circuit before delivery unless channel.preview_send=true. backend flag shape: `POST /v1/alerts/:id/preview { "channel_overrides": [{"channel_id":"slack:xxx","preview_send":false}] }`
Marcus: telemetry plan: emit `preview.route.eval` with {alert_id, matched_rules, channel_id, mode:"simulated|routed|canary", user_id}. debounce when preview auto-refreshes.
Rina: microcopy: change "preview send" control tooltip to "Send test message to channel (can be simulated)". avoid the word 'mute' here; it's confusing with our other features.
Yara: keyboard interactions: panel open should focus on the first channel row. each channel row: Enter to expand details, Space to toggle quick 'Send test' (if allowed). when toggling Send test, announce via live region: "Test send enabled for #alerts-ops".
Theo: visual affordance idea: when a preview is simulated, show a faint dotted connector from the alert card to channel rows with a tooltip "simulated only". when canary is active, show a gold dot and label "canary 10%".
Marcus: backend must still emit audit logs for preview attempts even if not delivered. AC: 1) preview evaluations recorded; 2) simulated previews do not consume rate-limited quota; 3) canary previews follow canary routing and require explicit opt-in.
Rina: a11y checks: ensure the dotted connectors are not the only indicator (use text labels) and high-contrast mode swaps color tokens. add aria-describedby on the channel rows pointing to a hidden explainer when a transformation applied.
Yara: copy tweak: change panel heading from "Route preview" to "Delivery preview" — clearer for non-platform folks. also add a short help text: "Shows which channels and transforms would run for this alert. Previews are simulated unless you choose Send test."
ops-bot: created ticket ALERT-6132 with tasks: API shape, telemetry, figma update, a11y checklist
Theo: I'll update the figma frames with Delivery preview + the status pill and add the connector states. tagging @Marcus for telemetry naming and @Rina for copy. will post updated frames here in ~12h :thumbsup:
Marcus: I'll draft the API PR behind feature flag `delivery_preview.v1` and add server-side tests for audit emission.
Rina: I'll run a micro copy review and produce 2 variants for the status pill: "Simulated  Not delivered" and "Test mode  Not delivered". also will add the tooltip text for transforms.
Yara: final a11y checklist: focus order, live region announcements, contrast tokens, ARIA names for status pill and transform badges, keyboard shortcuts doc. I'll attach as a checklist to the ticket.
Theo: perfect. closing loop here  will upload updated frames and acceptance criteria to ALERT-6132. Thanks!
